name: Template: age-banded vital sign flags
status: TEMPLATE: every limit is null and must be authored by the clinical lead. The app refuses to run it until all values are set.
_howToUse: Each criterion's value is {"byAge": [...]}. A band applies when the patient's age in months is below upToMonths and at or above the previous band's upToMonths (the first band starts at 0).
Edit the upToMonths cut points freely, but they must increase and the last one must be at least 216 (18 years).
Replace every null with a number taken from your local guideline.
Operators: lt, lte, gt, gte, eq. Open the app with ?pathway=pathways/age-banded-template.json (add &demo=1 for demo patients).
